openapi.title: CockroachDB Cloud API
openapi.mutability: The pinned URL is a commit-immutable GitHub mirror (cockroach-cloud-sdk-go@d1d13eb0) adopted 2026-07-20 after the vendor-owned spec asset vanished in a docs replatform. Generation fails closed unless bytes and SHA-256 match this reviewed contract; the immutable pin no longer self-detects upstream drift, so advancing is a deliberate reviewed re-pin.

source_decision.reason: CockroachDB Cloud exposes database infrastructure, identity provisioning, billing, networking, replication, and operational configuration. SCIM users/groups and organization folders are administrative hierarchy rather than semantically honest Recued tasks, notes, or user-work projects, and the authority proves no matching durable version plus deletion contract.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The vendor's latest OpenAPI URL and rendered Cloud API guide are mutable authorities.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Pinned both documents by byte count and SHA-256 and made regeneration fail closed on any drift before emitting artifacts.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The OpenAPI omits the strongly recommended Cc-Version header and combines date-versioned v1 routes with standards-based SCIM v2 routes.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Applied immutable Cc-Version 2024-09-16 to all 118 current /api/v1 operations and deliberately omitted it from all 21 SCIM v2 operations.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Five operations are explicitly provider-deprecated, including four legacy SCIM PUT searches.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Excluded the exact deprecated set while retaining their current GET, POST, or replacement PATCH counterparts.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The paginated role-grants response carries both grants and user_group_grants, but the follower can merge only one result array.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Left role-grant pagination caller-controlled and preserved both arrays instead of falsely certifying one merged array as the complete response.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Two SCIM collection searches carry count and startIndex inside required JSON bodies, while body_raw cannot be safely rewritten between pages.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Kept those two searches explicitly single-response and caller-paged; GET user/group lists receive safe automatic RFC 7644 offset walks.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Credential-shaped response fields have different security semantics: API-key creation returns a full unrecoverable secret, while formatted connection strings contain no password and Datadog returns only the final four key digits.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Schema-verified that boundary during generation, marked only API-key creation as secret-bearing, retained both safe reads as uncached workflows, and generated no mutation workflow that could render the newly created secret.

audit_findings_folded.finding: All 54 current request bodies are required nested JSON objects, including SCIM patches and credential-bearing configuration.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Requires bounded complete body_raw and sends it verbatim, avoiding lossy flattening of nested objects, arrays, nulls, and integer literals.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The repeated role_filter query array has no provider maximum but the closed request-schema gate requires a collection bound.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Applied a Recued 256-item request safety ceiling, preserved repeated-key serialization, and did not present the implementation bound as a CockroachDB limit.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Responses can contain integer fields whose exact range is not safe to infer from compacted schemas.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Enabled unsafe-integer preservation on every JSON response and projected int32 request parameters to explicit format-derived safe bounds.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The restore endpoint is POST-shaped but initiates data restoration, so a method-only policy would underclassify it as ordinary administration.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Added an operation-ID-locked destructive override for CreateRestore, retained non-idempotent retry semantics, and regression-tested the exact route.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Automatic inventory walks can encounter the documented 10 request/second/user limit.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Uses sequential gateway pagination, keeps reads uncached, documents Retry-After handling on every capability, and relies on gateway page and record ceilings.
